pageDescription: FAS Expedition – Your specialist for custom expedition vehicles. Vehicle construction, cabin construction and services from a single source.

intro.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: FAS Expedition combines expertise in body and commercial vehicle construction, engineering, technical drawing, electrical systems, and high-quality interior design with a substantial dose of innovation.
We offer our customers a complete expedition vehicle from a single source. The driving force of our team is off-road enthusiasm and a passion for travel.

We are driven to create world-class expedition vehicles for our customers, where the joy of autonomous travel takes center stage. We build with experience — our products are proven, tested, and have proven themselves countless times in the field.

services.title: Vehicle Construction
services.description: Chassis modifications, intermediate frames, wheelbase extensions and cabin shortening — everything that turns your vehicle into a true world travel mobile.

services.title: Cabin Construction
services.description: Innovative cabin design with masterfully crafted interior — equipped for all off-road levels.

services.title: Services
services.description: On- and off-road training, advice on recovery equipment, modifications — for all expedition vehicle owners.

cta.title: Meet Our Team
cta.description: Hardly an employee who is not infected with camping and travel fever.
